description: Add a new line item to a budget.

id.description: Unique identifier for this budget line item. Use as the {id} path parameter for the Show and Update endpoints.

original_budget_amount.description: Original budgeted amount for this line, before any budget changes.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the line's quantity, such as hours. Any value from the company's configured Units of Measure list.

quantity.description: Budgeted quantity in the line's unit of measure. Multiplied by unit_cost when calculation_strategy is 'automatic'.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit of measure. Multiplied by quantity when calculation_strategy is 'automatic'.

calculation_strategy.description: How original_budget_amount is derived, such as entered directly ('manual') or computed from quantity and unit_cost ('automatic').

wbs_code.description: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) code this line item is budgeted against.

id.description: Unique identifier of the WBS code. Pass as wbs_code_id when creating or updating a line item.

flat_code.description: Flattened WBS code string combining all segment values.

description.description: Human-readable description of the WBS code.

currency_configuration.description: Currency in which this line item's monetary amounts are denominated.

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the line item's amounts.

wbs_code_id.description: ID of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) code to budget this line against. Required.

original_budget_amount.description: Original budgeted amount for this line.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the quantity, such as hours. Must be a value from the company's Units of Measure list.
enum: Any value present in the Company list of Units of Measure

quantity.description: Budgeted quantity in the unit of measure. Used with unit_cost when calculation_strategy is 'automatic'.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit of measure. Used with quantity when calculation_strategy is 'automatic'.

calculation_strategy.description: Determines how the budgeted amount is derived for this line.
